notes.list_status: unofficial; the page states 'Candidate nominations are not final until certified after August 24' and that nominations are 'updated regularly as they are received'. Nominations close 2026-08-21 14:00.
notes.source_note: district_source_url is the City's Municipal Elections page, which gives the offices but no names; the names are one hop away on the Registered Candidates and Third-Party Advertisers page. Names are published as 'SURNAME, First', so the split is unambiguous.
notes.structure_match: One undifferentiated Councillor list under a single heading, with no wards anywhere on the page - which is the structure itself: North Bay elects its whole council in one at-large contest, matching the single structure-CSV row (n_districts 1, 10 seats, 10 votes).
notes.deputy_mayor: North Bay has a deputy mayor but no deputy mayor race: the councillor with the most votes takes the role, so there is no ballot line to collect.
